verdict.rationale: CIPO's own patents page publishes 'Log in to MyCIPO Patents' as the entry point, which signals before you start that patent filing goes through an account. The trademarks page places 'Apply for/amend a trademark' under an online-services block. Neither page spells out the specific credential or identity-proofing steps involved. Missing for 10: an explicit upfront list of account, credential and identity-verification requirements per filing type (patent, trademark, design, copyright), trademark-side account disclosure, and hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.
